source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, cover TEMP_NIC_QSFP0~1, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list representations and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 28.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but fabricates one aggregate title sensor, truncates OOB-only evidence and loses explicit indices 0 and 1.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires independent QSFP0/QSFP1 cage/module/port evidence and empty-cage rules.

old_problem: The source explicitly names QSFP indices 0 through 1, but `grep TEMP_NIC_QSFP0~1` is not a dependable range expansion and DeepSeek collapses both to a nonexistent aggregate title sensor. No physical cage/module/port mapping or populated-versus-empty behavior is defined; criteria jump from 2 to 28.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by expanding the source's explicit range into two independently traceable members, never by guessing a regex or aggregate record. ED-03 permits cage/module/port identities and installed-state as runtime Project Configuration, ED-08 retains both Web rows, ED-13 requires SPEC proof before N/A for an empty cage, and ED-15 bars invented limits.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2024, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2025 / Wistron-BMC-01045-V002 / 3c7b8914d4e8356c.
QSFP0 and QSFP1 are separate coverage identities; neither can substitute for the other and `0~1` must not be passed as a literal completeness filter.
Each populated cage is bound to NIC, physical cage, logical port and module PN/serial/firmware; an empty cage may lack module telemetry only when the approved SPEC defines that absence.
Full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus both Web mappings establish reporting parity; passive speed/FEC/link/traffic context is evidence, not authorization to manipulate optics or links.
Criteria 1, 2 and 28 are preserved without fabricating criteria 3-27.
No ipmitool, module query, authentication, Web capture, optical handling, link action, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: QSFP0 and QSFP1 cage/module-bound temperature-sensor reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the two required NIC QSFP sensor identities independently, binding each index to its physical cage, port and installed module state and reconciling complete telemetry across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/NIC identity and explicit QSFP0/QSFP1 physical cage plus logical-port map
Per-cage populated/empty state and module PN/serial/firmware with approved absent-telemetry behavior
Versioned TEMP_NIC_QSFP0 and TEMP_NIC_QSFP1 five-view crosswalk, units/ranges/states/thresholds/freshness
Passive speed/FEC/link/traffic/airflow context, approved ipmitool and protected Web/OOB access
Network/optics/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; build a two-row QSFP0/QSFP1 matrix bound to NIC, cage, port and module identity or approved empty state. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs before selecting each stable record separately; capture both relevant Web rows/pages and passive speed/FEC/link/traffic/thermal context. Compare each member to SPEC. Do not use `0~1` as a literal range filter, aggregate the indices, insert/remove modules, flap ports, change optics/network settings, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: QSFP0 and QSFP1 each have the SPEC-defined record or approved empty-cage absence, correct cage/module/port attribution and fresh consistent fields in all applicable views, with no new link/FEC/optical/thermal fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent evidence for both indices, exact mapping, complete applicable views and approved limits/absence rules. FAIL on swapped mapping, missing required member, unexpected record for an empty cage, duplicate/stale/mismatched value, exceeded limit or new link/FEC/thermal fault. Unspecified occupancy or absence behavior is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no module insertion/removal, link flap, traffic stress, firmware/configuration or threshold write.
Protect credentials and preserve full inventories before per-index selection.
Stop on ambiguous cage mapping, unexpected module state, link/FEC degradation, missing/duplicate/stale record or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first discrepancy and physical occupancy context.
expected_evidence: Two-row QSFP0/QSFP1 cage/port/module-or-empty matrix and versioned spec
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for each applicable index
Per-index field comparison plus passive module/link/FEC/traffic/thermal context
Criteria numbering and no-optical-action/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit plus verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong cage mapping, access failure, unexpected occupancy, missing/mismatched telemetry, link/FEC degradation or thermal alarm, stop and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not touch optics, flap links, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact cage, port and module serial.

source_conflict.reason: An explicit two-member physical matrix replaces unreliable `0~1` filtering and the synthetic aggregate target; SPEC-defined empty-cage behavior governs applicability.

blocked.reason: The two-member passive objective and safety contract are complete; cage/module identities and limits are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: QSFP0/QSFP1 cage/port mapping, module occupancy/identity, per-index crosswalk/limits and approved empty-cage behavior.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TWO-MEMBER QSFP MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, MODULE QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, OPTICAL/LINK ACTION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
